positions.name: GateAuthorityMandate
positions.frame: what establishes this gate as a binding requirement rather than a proposal or suggestion?
positions.why: Across these four expressions the directional reads (relational: authority-ranking; power: legitimate) converge on the same enactment — a requirement declared, restated, scoped, and owned as settled binding fact rather than argued or negotiated. src-1 issues the requirement, src-3 restates it as a labeled gate, src-4 fixes its jurisdiction, and src-5 names the accountable position-holder. The tension the set holds is between directive (src-1) and declarative (src-3/4/5) speech-act form — same mandate, performed twice: once as command, once as recorded rule.
